context: Reuse tests.utilities.posix_shell for the interpreter path, generate the minimum platform-specific launcher in the test fixture, and keep production executor version/age rejection unchanged.
description: The action-loop test writes an extensionless bash-shebang executable named codex. Windows shutil.which uses PATHEXT and cannot resolve it. The action order remains executor, commit, then reply.

verifications.expected: fails on the unfixed Windows tree because codex is not found; exit 0 after repair
